basic_info.description: Introducing an exceptional investment opportunity in San Francisco's coveted Lake Street District. Prime Lake Street District Mid-century 4 units. This well maintained apartment building, built in 1965, offers 4 spacious 2 bedroom 2 bath units,  terrazzo entry, parking for 4 cars and ADU potential. Separate gas and electric meters. Zoned RH2, this prime location presents an unmissable prospect for the savvy investor, partners or multi-generational owner occupants.
